unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፲፫ — Meraf 13: Grand Master of ፐ (Latin Pe)

success_screen.headline_en: Glorious! You are the Grand Master of some of the rarest characters!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! ብርቅዬ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: POLIS
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'POLIS' (Police) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ፓፓያ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Papaya' (Papaya). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ፓያ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ፓፓያ (pronounced Pa-pa-ya).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ፓፓያ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Papaya (Papaya)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 4th form 'ፓ', followed by another 'ፓ', and end in 'ያ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: PAPAYA
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'PAPAYA' (Papaya) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ፕ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'P' sound of the ፐ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ፒያኖ
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Piano (Piano)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 3rd form 'ፒ', then 4th form 'ያ', and end in 7th form 'ኖ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: PIANO
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'PIANO' with the correct Amharic word.
